name: Liver FNA cytology – proposed 5-tier scheme (NOT a WHO system)
edition: Consensus/proposed – no WHO liver cytopathology book published

adequacy.title: Adequacy
items: Representative lesional cells; cell block for IHC.

categories.name: Insufficient / Inadequate / Non-diagnostic

rom.source: Literature (approx.; ROM not established by WHO; unverified)

criteria: Blood, necrosis only, normal hepatocytes from a mass lesion (non-representative).

diagnoses.name: Non-diagnostic
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Liver FNA (proposed scheme) – Insufficient/Inadequate/Non-diagnostic

categories.name: Benign

rom.source: Literature (approx.; ROM not established by WHO; unverified)

criteria: Abscess, hydatid cyst, haemangioma, focal nodular hyperplasia (limited), cirrhotic nodule, granulomas.

diagnoses.name: Liver abscess (pyogenic/amoebic)
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Liver FNA (proposed scheme) – Benign

diagnoses.name: Hydatid cyst
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Liver FNA (proposed scheme) – Benign

diagnoses.name: Granulomatous hepatitis
diagnoses.comment: Epithelioid granulomas; consider TB, sarcoidosis, drugs, PBC; AFB/fungal stains and culture.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Liver FNA (proposed scheme) – Benign

diagnoses.name: Benign hepatocytes (consistent with regenerative nodule)
diagnoses.final: Benign (Liver FNA (proposed scheme)). Benign hepatocytes (consistent with regenerative nodule).
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Liver FNA (proposed scheme) – Benign

diagnoses.name: Atypical hepatocytes
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Liver FNA (proposed scheme) – Atypical

categories.name: Suspicious for malignancy

rom.source: Literature (approx.; ROM not established by WHO; unverified)

criteria: Well-differentiated hepatocytic lesion with some features of HCC.

diagnoses.name: Suspicious for hepatocellular carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Suspicious for malignancy (Liver FNA (proposed scheme)). Suspicious for hepatocellular carcinoma.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Liver FNA (proposed scheme) – Suspicious for malignancy

categories.name: Malignant

rom.source: Literature (approx.; ROM not established by WHO; unverified)

criteria: HCC: trabeculae, endothelial wrapping, naked nuclei, high N:C.

diagnoses.name: Hepatocellular carcinoma
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Liver FNA (proposed scheme) – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Liver FNA (proposed scheme) – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Metastatic adenocarcinoma (colorectal etc.)
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Liver FNA (proposed scheme)). Metastatic adenocarcinoma (colorectal etc.).
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Liver FNA (proposed scheme) – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Metastatic neuroendocrine tumour
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Liver FNA (proposed scheme)). Metastatic neuroendocrine tumour.
diagnoses.comment: Monotonous plasmacytoid cells with salt-and-pepper chromatin; synaptophysin/chromogranin, Ki-67 for grade; search for GEP primary.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Liver FNA (proposed scheme) – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Hepatoblastoma
diagnoses.comment: Paediatric; fetal/embryonal small hepatoid cells ± mesenchymal elements; glypican-3/β-catenin; serum AFP.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Liver FNA (proposed scheme) – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Lymphoma
diagnoses.comment: Discohesive atypical lymphoid cells with lymphoglandular bodies; send for flow cytometry and cell block IHC.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Liver FNA (proposed scheme) – Malignant

extra.title: Caution
items: No WHO/IAC-IARC liver cytopathology reporting book exists (checked on WHO Classification of Tumours online, Oct 2026). This page uses a 5-tier scheme modelled on the other IAC-IARC systems as a consensus framework.
ROM values are not established – figures shown are single-study approximations.

references: WHO Classification of Tumours Editorial Board. Digestive System Tumours. 5th ed. IARC, 2019 (entity definitions).
